(DOCTOR) 275.25-286.39s: From what you've told me and what I found, I'd lean towards hypertension that isn't well controlled. I'd like to arrange a lipid profile for cardiovascular risk.\nperson_1 (PATIENT) 287.09-289.64s: Alright, when would that be?\nperson_2 (DOCTOR) 290.97-301.49s: I'm going to put you on telmisartan, 40 milligrams, once a day, long term. You take it by mouth. That's for high blood pressure.\nperson_1 (PATIENT) 303.03-304.61s: Okay, thank you.\nperson_2 (DOCTOR) 305.31-328.60s: Salt is the big one, try to keep it low even though it's hard.
